### Hawaii Packing List

#### Clothing
- Lightweight shorts and t-shirts
- Swimwear
- Light jacket for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals
- Hiking boots for volcano hikes

#### Essentials
- Sunscreen
- Beach towel
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkel and mask
- Sun hat
- Travel-sized toiletries

#### Documents
- Passport
- Travel insurance
- Hotel confirmation
- Credit cards

#### Miscellaneous
- Camera
- Chargers and adapters
- Travel guidebook
- First-aid kit
- Cash and small bills

Enjoy your trip to Hawaii!
